english.note: TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo required for applicable international applicants unless qualifying education exempts them. School recommends TOEFL5.0/legacy100, IELTS7.5, DET135 without mandatory cutoff; older department wording says TOEFL above100. Confirm expectations.

applicationFee.note: Waivers for qualifying low-income U.S. citizens/permanent residents and applicants with Penn/U.S. military affiliation. International applicants should confirm Penn-affiliation eligibility.

documents: Unofficial transcripts from each institution where course credit was earned
requirements.note: Medical Physics concentration requires three letters. Strong quantitative preparation and biology foundation expected; no specific course requirements.

funding.note: Full funding throughout doctoral study in good academic standing: tuition/fees, single health/dental insurance and annual living wage.
